player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Mart''') posted a [[Dark]] [[Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|Carbon Chamber Testing]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.

starting.card: Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration

description: This deck went 4-0 in the swedish championships and is the reason i won it. never beaten in tournaments
cards: Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration
Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith
notes: The post says the deck went 4-0 at the Swedish championships and that Martin Akesson won the event with it; the wiki has no event page yet.

No starting section is posted. The objective is Carbon Chamber Testing; the strategy says to always start Mobilization Points and Crush The Rebellion, with You Cannot Hide Forever or Secret Plans as the third Effect, so no single starting Effect is set. Prepared Defenses is in the list.

Posted 'Carbon Chamber Testing/bla' dested Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration; 'CCsecurity tower' dested Cloud City: Security Tower; 'CCcarboninte chamber' dested the Dark Cloud City: Carbonite Chamber; 'CCdocking bay' dested Cloud City: East Platform (Docking Bay), the Dark Cloud City docking bay the objective names; 'Tatooine docking bay' dested the Dark Tatooine: Docking Bay 94; 'jp audience chamber' dested the Dark Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber.

Posted 'Tarkin' dested Grand Moff Tarkin (Premiere), which cancels an opponent's destiny when with Vader, as the strategy describes; 'Lando Carlrissian' dested the Dark Lando Calrissian (pulled by the Security Tower); 'Dr. E & Ponda B' dested Dr. Evazan & Ponda Baba; 'IG88 with gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; '4LOM with gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'omnibox& its worse' dested Ommni Box & It's Worse; 'Mara Jade' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'vader with saber' dested Darth Vader With Lightsaber.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001, not a Defensive Shield.
Posted 'suprise assault' is printed as written: Surprise Assault is a Light Side card and there is no Dark Side version (the Dark Counter Surprise Assault does not do what the strategy describes).
